mapper.select: SELECT member_id, email, name, phone, role, status, withdrawn_at FROM MEMBER ORDER BY created_at DESC, member_id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET status = #{status}, withdrawn_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'INACTIVE' THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE NULL END, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE MEMBER SET role = 'USER', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND role = 'ADMIN'
